definitions.definition: The capacity of people to maintain belief in an institution or a goal, or even in oneself and others.

quote.citation: 2012 November 2, Ken Belson, New York Times‎[1], retrieved 2 November 2012:
quote.text: Proponents of the race — notably Mayor Michael R. Bloomberg and Mary Wittenberg, director of the marathon — said the event would provide a needed morale boost, as well as an economic one.
